description: Demonstrated experience in all aspect of the International aircraft validation / acceptance process from application submittal to granting of a validated type certificate.
Lead subject matter expert on foreign regulations with regards to certification & operations. Managed external contract engineering design groups with regards Type Design changes.

I developed and managed internal engineering disciplines, FAA, and foreign authority project teams during the validation process. Developed departmental procedures based on international bilateral agreements, governmental regulation and operational requirements.
As the IC Program Manager coordinated certification activities with internal functions and direct FAA involvement.
Develop certification procedures as required and reviewed company documentation to meet FAA & foreign civil aviation authority requirements.
Reviewd compliance documentation, design data, Certification Plans, Compliance Reports, Drawings, wrote internal company coordination memos prior to domestic and foreign government submission.
I developed compliance packages and submitted directly to the FAA and foreign authority.
Improved guidelines in implementing certification programs while maintaining budgetary and schedule constraints.
Ensured compliance to multi-national agreements and regulatory framework Experienced in US federal regulations 14CFR 61, 91, 23, 135.
Developed and managed maintenance and avionic customer accounts, processed invoice payments, credits and net account billing. Prepared maintenance/avionics invoices.

Managed subscription based navigational data for company charter operations & customer based aircraft. Coordinated invoicing, account management of all maintenance and avionics repairs for a FAA 145 repair station. Managed pilot supplies, purchase orders, inventory control cycling of life limited products.

matchmaking_summary: The candidate has extensive experience in international aviation and aerospace management, including aircraft certification, regulatory compliance, import/export processes, and sales support. With over 14 years of professional experience and a successful track record in obtaining First of Type approvals for foreign markets, the candidate demonstrates strong expertise in navigating complex regulations and managing global projects. Their role involves leading subject matter experts on foreign regulations, developing internal procedures, coordinating with FAA and foreign authorities, and ensuring compliance to multi-national agreements.
